name: Avash Dhungel
tagline: Engineering Student • Pulchowk Campus • Knowledge Sharing
shortBio: I'm an engineering student at Pulchowk Campus, Institute of Engineering (IOE), Nepal. I document my academic journey, write concise engineering notes, build small projects, and share resources for fellow students.

about.intro: I'm Avash Dhungel, an engineering student at Pulchowk Campus — one of Nepal's premier engineering institutions under the Institute of Engineering (IOE). This site is my digital home: a living record of my studies, my projects, and my attempt to make engineering notes and resources genuinely useful for other students.

sections.title: Why this site exists
sections.body: Engineering courses move fast and notes get scattered — PDFs on class groups, whiteboard photos, half-finished handwritten pages. I'm putting my organized, reviewed notes online so that a student who doesn't know me personally can still benefit from them, and so my own study materials have one stable home.

sections.title: What I'm interested in
sections.body: Core engineering sciences right now: surveying, strength of materials and engineering geology. Beyond coursework I'm drawn to how software and electronics shape engineering practice — building tools that make studying and fieldwork easier.

sections.title: What you'll find here
sections.body: Subject-wise engineering notes, previous-year questions, study guides, project write-ups, a documentation of my academic journey, and videos where I explain the things I'm learning.

availability: Open to internships, study collaborations and note-review requests.
